extraction.notes: No identifiable summer 2026 or 2027 camp schedule or registration dates were found on the official website or in search results. The Camps and Choreography page advertises custom camps for school and recreation teams throughout WNC, but does not establish summer timing, a finite session, or a drop-off location. Its free gym-training promotion refers to 2022. The supplied registration portal text contains no camp listings. Custom team camps may warrant a direct inquiry; no summer camp card could be substantiated from the available materials.
